ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels covering the lower and central regions, vs 25% high-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels concentrated along the upper trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-pixel region occupying the base and mid-section; two symmetrical high-intensity white regions on the distal-superior lobes containing dense black linear mottling and focal spotting.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65-75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge, with prominent pixel-peaks (protrusions) located roughly 40% along the trajectory from notch to tip on both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the lower boundary leading to tips; trailing edges exhibit an asymmetrical convex sweep toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast white/grey pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense manifestation of dark-on-white linear rake marks and vertical scratches concentrated in the white pigmentation zones of the upper fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at distal tips; irregular jagged indentations along the trailing edge suggestive of non-uniform tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine-grain white speckling (micro-mottling) distributed across the lower 50% of the primarily black ventral surface.
